title: Ceḷa
text: 2. Āditte bhikkhave cele vā sīse vā kim assa karaṇīyan ti || || Āditte bhante cele vā sīse vā tasseva celassa vā sīsassa vā nibbāpanāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ ca karaṇīyan ti || || 3. Ādittam bhikkhave celaṃ vā sīsaṃ vā ajjhupekkhitvā amanasikaritvā anabhisametānam catunnam ariyasaccānam yathābhūtam abhisamayāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appativānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ ca karaṇīyaṃ || katamesaṃ catunnaṃ || || 4. Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || la-pe || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa || || 5. Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karanīyo ti || pa-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti yogo karanīyo ti || ||
